items.title: Cannes Prize-Winning ‘Brink of Dreams’ Director Ayman El Amir Preps Dark Comedy About Egypt’s Obsession With ‘Fame at All Costs’ (EXCLUSIVE)
items.title_zh: 戛纳电影节获奖导演艾曼·艾尔·阿米尔准备拍摄一部黑色喜剧，讲述埃及对“不惜一切代价成名”的痴迷（独家）
items.summary: Egyptian filmmaker Ayman El Amir, who co-directed the groundbreaking, Cannes prize-winning documentary “The Brink of Dreams,” is developing his next feature, “A Pair of Shoes in the Dark Corner of the Moon.” The satirical comedy is among the projects that will be taking part in…
items.summary_zh: 埃及电影制片人艾曼·阿米尔 (Ayman El Amir) 是戛纳获奖纪录片《梦想的边缘》的联合导演，他正在开发他的下一部影片《月球黑暗角落里的一双鞋》。这部讽刺喜剧是将参加的项目之一……

items.title: Tate McRae and Doechii Choreographer Robbie Blue Among World Choreography Award Winners
items.title_zh: 泰特·麦克雷 (Tate McRae) 和多奇伊 (Doechii) 编舞家罗比·布鲁 (Robbie Blue) 荣获世界编舞奖
items.summary: Robbie Blue, the choreographer for pop and rap stars Tate McRae and Doechii, took home three World Choreography Awards at the 2026 ceremony. He and his associates were recognized for the intricate moves of McRae’s “Saturday Night Live” dance and Doechii’s electric 67th Grammys…
items.summary_zh: 流行音乐和说唱明星 Tate McRae 和 Doechii 的编舞者 Robbie Blue 在 2026 年颁奖典礼上荣获三项世界编舞奖。他和他的同事们因 McRae 的《周六夜现场》舞蹈和 Doechii 的第 67 届格莱美电子舞曲中复杂的动作而受到认可……

items.title: Is Jensen Huang’s job on the line? Yale’s Jeffrey Sonnenfeld estimates it’s “about a 50-50”
items.title_zh: 黄仁勋的工作岌岌可危吗？耶鲁大学的 Jeffrey Sonnenfeld 估计“大约是 50-50”
items.summary: Nvidia’s board is investigating Jensen Huang over his relationship with a suspected Chinese spy, and Yale’s Jeffrey Sonnenfeld thinks it’s roughly a coin flip whether Huang stays on as CEO.
items.summary_zh: 英伟达董事会正在调查黄仁勋与一名疑似中国间谍的关系，耶鲁大学的杰弗里·索南菲尔德认为，黄仁勋是否继续担任首席执行官，这几乎是一个硬币决定问题。

items.title: From supermarket fridges to passenger flights, a wave of threats is testing Europe's defenses
items.title_zh: 从超市冰箱到客运航班，一波威胁正在考验欧洲的防御能力
items.summary: Cyberattacks on fridges in supermarkets and a wave of bomb threats are testing Europe’s ability to withstand disruption to crucial infrastructure.
items.summary_zh: 针对超市冰箱的网络攻击和一波炸弹威胁正在考验欧洲抵御关键基础设施破坏的能力。

items.title: China wholesale inflation hits highest in more than four years as consumer measure slows
items.title_zh: 随着消费者指标放缓，中国批发通胀创四年多来新高
items.summary: The PPI for October came in at 5.7%, compared to the 5.3% expected by economists polled by Reuters.
items.summary_zh: 10 月份 PPI 为 5.7%，而路透社调查的经济学家预期为 5.3%。

items.title: Here’s the full text of Jensen Huang’s memo to Nvidia
items.title_zh: 以下是黄仁勋给 Nvidia 的备忘录全文
items.summary: On Sunday, Nvidia announced it was launching an investigation into CEO Jensen Huang's relationship with Alice Huang, an AI executive and agent of the Chinese government.
items.summary_zh: 周日，英伟达宣布将对首席执行官黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 与人工智能高管兼中国政府代理人 Alice Huang 的关系展开调查。

items.title: Nvidia investigates CEO Jensen Huang's relationship with alleged Chinese spy
items.title_zh: 英伟达调查首席执行官黄仁勋与涉嫌中国间谍的关系
items.summary: Huang told Nvidia staff in an email that he had an affair and that the company's board has opened an investigation into allegations the woman is a Chinese spy.
items.summary_zh: 黄在一封电子邮件中告诉英伟达员工，他有外遇，该公司董事会已开始调查该女子是中国间谍的指控。

items.title: Apps to distract you from the endless cycle of doomscrolling
items.title_zh: 应用程序可以分散您对末日滚动的无尽循环的注意力
items.summary: It's hard to break the cycle of doomscrolling, but there are plenty of apps that can help you spend more time on content that’s engaging and productive.
items.summary_zh: 打破末日滚动的循环很困难，但有很多应用程序可以帮助您将更多时间花在有吸引力和高效的内容上。

items.title: AI giant Nvidia launches investigation into CEO's affair with 'Chinese spy'
items.title_zh: 人工智能巨头英伟达对首席执行官与“中国间谍”的恋情展开调查
items.summary: The chief executive of tech giant Nvidia has admitted having an affair, with the company investigating reports that he was targeted by a foreign intelligence effort.
items.summary_zh: 科技巨头英伟达首席执行官承认有外遇，该公司正在调查有关他成为外国情报机构目标的报道。

items.title: Seven dead and 114 injured in train crash near Cairo
items.title_zh: 开罗附近火车相撞事故造成7人死亡、114人受伤
items.summary: At least seven people have died and more than 100 have been left injured in a major train crash south of Cairo, according to the Egyptian Chief Prosecutor’s office.
items.summary_zh: 据埃及首席检察官办公室称，开罗以南发生的一起重大火车相撞事故已造成至少 7 人死亡、100 多人受伤。
